Sodium warning:
keep intake under 2,000mg/day — swelling can worsen with excess salt.
Sugar warning: limit added sugar to support wound healing. Protein goal: 70g/day for tissue repair.
Meal reminder: lunch in 1h 40m. Nutrition notes: dietitian follow-up scheduled for day 10.
